component: Compose signature predicate JSDoc and callers

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The maintenance patch adds @param {Node} aNode to an unchanged predicate. The helper first matches nodeName against DIV/PRE, then checks moz-signature, so the annotation describes the supplied node role rather than introducing element-only access or new behavior. The implementation still requires a non-null node. The new-message caller guards firstElementChild; the reply paragraph branch has no local null check. Upstream reply-body guarantees and runtime failure were not established. The accepted endpoint retains the helper while later new-message setup differs. This is a bounded comment/caller contract, not a compose behavior change or a new global JSDoc rule.
title: The isSignature parameter documents a node without adding a null guard
